adopt_help.output:
Usage: localharness autoresearch adopt [OPTIONS] ID                                                
                                                                                                    
 Adopt a HELD item into LIVE config (a write to the GLOBAL user overlay — no git commit).           
                                                                                                    
 A ``adoption_rejected`` row is kept as parent material and never re-offered (refused, exit 2);     
 an already-``adopted`` row is a no-op (exit 0). On a successful adopt the row's status flips to    
 ``adopted`` and the repo HEAD the win was measured at is printed as provenance. Undo an            
 adoption with ``localharness components set <path> <before>`` (the archive row keeps both          
 values); the repo itself is never modified.                                                        
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    id      TEXT  8-char hex prefix or full UUID of a held item [required]                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --json            Emit the adoption result as JSON                                               │
│ --help  -h        Show this message and exit.                                                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

experiment_run_help.output:
Usage: localharness experiment run [OPTIONS] PROPOSAL_ID                                           
                                                                                                    
 Run <proposal_id> through the two-stage gate. Exit code IS the verdict: 0=promote, 1=reject-train, 
 2=reject-holdout, 3=inconclusive; >=4=structural refusal.                                          
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    proposal_id      TEXT  Archive id (full UUID or 8-char prefix) of an in_flight proposal     │
│                             [required]                                                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --trials          INTEGER  Trial family size for Bonferroni correction (alpha = 0.05 / trials)   │
│                            [default: 1]                                                          │
│ --keep                     Keep the git worktree for debugging (default: remove)                 │
│ --json                     Emit the verdict as JSON                                              │
│ --help    -h               Show this message and exit.                                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

propose_help.output:
Usage: localharness propose [OPTIONS]                                                              
                                                                                                    
 Generate ONE typed mutation {diff, rationale} for ONE component from failed TRAIN traces.          
                                                                                                    
 Seal refusals (holdout/unknown/no-evidence/malformed/off-target) surface as exit 2.                
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  --component          TEXT  Dot-path of the component to mutate (e.g. agent.role) [required]   │
│ *  --traces             TEXT  TRAIN run_ids {model}/{scenario}/{timestamp} (repeatable)          │
│                               [required]                                                         │
│    --json                     Emit JSON {component, diff, rationale}                             │
│    --archive                  Persist an in_flight archive row (default: return-only)            │
│    --help       -h            Show this message and exit.                                        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

report_help.output:
Usage: localharness autoresearch report [OPTIONS]                                                  
                                                                                                    
 Render the async human-review surface: trajectory + Pareto table + inbox + sentinel alerts.        
                                                                                                    
 ``--show <id>`` drills into one mutation instead. A timestamped markdown snapshot is written       
 under ``<home>/autoresearch/reports/`` every run. An empty/absent archive is a normal survey       
 result (exit 0, mirrors ``archive list``).                                                         
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --show                    TEXT     Drill into one mutation by id/prefix (change + hypothesis +   │
│                                    proof + lineage)                                              │
│ --json                             (reserved) emit structured output                             │
│ --overfit-gap             FLOAT    Override sentinel.overfit_gap_threshold                       │
│ --dup-similarity          FLOAT    Override sentinel.duplicate_similarity                        │
│ --dup-k                   INTEGER  Override sentinel.duplicate_consecutive_k                     │
│ --saturation-k            INTEGER  Override sentinel.saturation_k                                │
│ --help            -h               Show this message and exit.                                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

review_help.output:
Usage: localharness autoresearch review [OPTIONS]                                                  
                                                                                                    
 List HELD items as review cards (component, before->after diff, lift, p-value, id).                
                                                                                                    
 Only ``held`` rows are reviewable — ``adoption_rejected`` rows are kept as parent material

│ --limit          INTEGER  Max held items to surface (default 50) [default: 50]                   │
│ --json                    Emit held items as a JSON array                                        │
│ --help   -h               Show this message and exit.                                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

run_help.output:
Usage: localharness autoresearch run [OPTIONS]                                                     
                                                                                                    
 Drive the autonomous self-improvement loop until a budget/breaker/interrupt halts.                 
                                                                                                    
 Exit code is the RUN code: 0 on ANY clean halt (budget / circuit_breaker / interrupt /             
 complete). The ONLY non-zero exits are an early bad-flag or config-error (exit 2) — a gate         
 verdict NEVER becomes the run's exit code (Pitfall 5).                                             
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --budget                        TEXT     wallclock cap, e.g. 4h, 30m (default: until the 5h      │
│                                          window is ~spent)                                       │
│ --max-cost                      FLOAT    USD cap (sums archive per-row cost; ~$0 for a local     │
│                                          proposer)                                               │
│ --max-iterations                INTEGER  hard iteration backstop so a metering bug can't loop    │
│                                          forever                                                 │
│                                          [default: 1000]                                         │
│ --checkpoint-every              INTEGER  reserved (held items surface in the report; this loop   │
│                                          is fire-and-forget)                                     │
│                                          [default: 5]                                            │
│ --epsilon                       FLOAT    explore probability for the parent sampler              │
│                                          [default: 0.2]                                          │
│ --min-lift                      FLOAT    effect-size floor for auto-adoption; default unset —    │
│                                          calibrate from early-run data (see journal)             │
│ --proposal-timeout              TEXT     hard-kill a single hung experiment [default: 30m]       │
│ --claude-window-tokens          INTEGER  proposer 5h-window token budget; set to match your Max  │
│                                          plan                                                    │
│ --json                                   emit the RunSummary as JSON                             │
│ --help                  -h               Show this message and exit.                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

sentinel_help.output:
Usage: localharness autoresearch sentinel [OPTIONS]                                                
                                                                                                    
 Run ONLY the eval-sentinel pass (gaps + duplicates + the rotation suggestion); cron-friendly.      
                                                                                                    
 Same pass as the inline section of ``report``, standalone. Writes a markdown snapshot too.         
 The rotation suggestion NEVER names a sealed eval-slice fixture (the seal is preserved by          
 ``saturated_fixtures``). An empty/absent archive is exit 0.                                        
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --json                             (reserved) emit structured output                             │
│ --overfit-gap             FLOAT    Override sentinel.overfit_gap_threshold                       │
│ --dup-similarity          FLOAT    Override sentinel.duplicate_similarity                        │
│ --dup-k                   INTEGER  Override sentinel.duplicate_consecutive_k                     │
│ --saturation-k            INTEGER  Override sentinel.saturation_k                                │
│ --help            -h               Show this message and exit.                                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
